units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 4:8">Targ. Prov. IV, 8</cite> <he>חַבִּבְיָהּ</he> honor her.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 33:3">Targ. O. Deut. XXXIII, 3</cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Shabbat 130a">Sabb. 130ᵃ</cite> is it <he>משום חַבּוּבֵי מצוה</he> (Rashi <cite ref="H00653"><he>חִיבּוּב</he></cite>) in order to show the high appreciation of the ceremony (of circumcision)?—
<cite ref="Chullin 133a:5">Ḥull. 133ᵃ</cite> <he>חבובי קא מְחַבֵּב וכ׳</he> does he (by taking hastily) prove his anxiety for the divine command, or &c.?
